description: gnomon task --graph <file>: a task graph whose every node has its own external check. CONTRACTS.md section 64. Pinned by packages/gnomon-cli/src/graph.test.ts, packages/gnomon-core/src/task_graph.test.ts and the audit schema.

graph_file.files_match: a path equal to an entry, or under it as a directory; entries normalised; case folded on win32 and darwin

refusals: a node with no instruction or no files
a dep the graph does not declare, or a cycle
a role the surface does not define
uncommitted changes in the working tree
verified_when: every node done, every merge clean, every node's check and [verify] passed again on the merged tree
apply: only a verified integration, only with --apply, only if HEAD is still the base commit and none of its paths changed in the operator's tree; never a conflict or a partial graph
